source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 27 April 1933, p. 16 ("Down local elections: Castlereagh")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the nine names and their divisions read from the News-Letter's Castlereagh nomination list (27 April 1933, p. 16), which states 'There will be no contests for the nine seats'

note: Triennial election of the nine rural district councillors, one for each electoral division. Nominations closed on 26 April 1933 and, there being no contest in any division, the nine nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Down took place on 25 May 1933. Filed on 1933-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Robb. Returned unopposed.
